note: Sources the pilot dataset actually cites, with their licence. Loaded into the `source` table by the seed_reference job and rendered on the sources page. A licence that could not be read from the source's own terms page in this session is recorded as null with a note saying so - never as a guessed licence string. Two terms pages (reliefweb.int/terms-conditions and data.humdata.org/faqs/licenses) returned HTTP 403 to an automated fetch on 2026-08-28; where the project research had already established the licence, that is stated as the origin of the claim.

sources.name: ReliefWeb (OCHA)
sources.licence_note: Report texts stay under the copyright of the publishing organisation named on each update. We store the body text for extraction only and publish a quote of at most 40 words plus the link. The terms page returned HTTP 403 to an automated fetch on 2026-08-28, so no licence string is asserted here.

sources.name: OCHA HDX / Humanitarian API - Nepal administrative boundaries
sources.licence_note: Creative Commons Attribution, established during the project research phase and recorded in README.md. The version number is deliberately not stated: the HDX licence FAQ returned HTTP 403 to an automated fetch on 2026-08-28, so it could not be confirmed. Source of the 77 district codes and names.

sources.name: IATI Registry and d-portal
sources.licence_note: There is no single licence: each publisher chooses its own. The Nepal publisher list in data/raw/iati/registry_publishers_np.json carries cc-by, cc-zero, odc-by, odc-pddl, gfdl, other-open and notspecified. Reuse has to be checked per publisher.

sources.name: Charity Commission for England and Wales
sources.licence_note: Established during the project research phase and recorded in README.md. Trustee data is deliberately not ingested: the database holds no natural persons.

sources.name: ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer (IRS Form 990 data)
sources.licence_note: The underlying IRS filings are US government works in the public domain. ProPublica's own presentation and API terms were not re-read in this session, so no licence string is asserted for the service itself.

sources.name: DZI Spenden-Siegel (Deutsches Zentralinstitut fuer soziale Fragen)
sources.licence_note: Organisation profiles are published by DZI for public consultation; no open-data licence is offered. Cited by link, never republished in bulk.

sources.name: ZEWO (Swiss certification body for charitable organisations)
sources.licence_note: Certification entries are published for public consultation; no open-data licence is offered. Cited by link, never republished in bulk.

sources.name: Organisation websites and annual reports
sources.licence_note: Each organisation's own pages and published reports, under that organisation's copyright. Used as the source for self-reported facts; cited by link with a short quote.

sources.name: Media reports
sources.licence_note: News coverage under the publisher's copyright. Cited by link with a short quote, never republished.

sources.name: Wikipedia
sources.licence_note: A tertiary source. Used only where no primary source was reachable, and always visible as such through the verification grade on the value.
